tidbits.title: Two panes
tidbits.eta_note: wrong pane wastes a full session
tidbits.body: A15 paths start /data/data/com.termux or /storage/emulated/0. SSH paths start /home/jesse. Refuse the other.

tidbits.title: Bash is not Python
tidbits.body: $ means bash. python3 file.py runs a file. python3 alone opens >>>. Never paste def/import at $.

tidbits.title: One working tree
tidbits.body: Use /data/data/com.termux/files/home/code/openroot. Leave /data/data/com.termux/files/home/src/openroot idle. Mesh is not git.

tidbits.title: git add takes a real path
tidbits.body: git add /data/data/com.termux/files/home/code/openroot/bin/probe.json  then git status. Never git add PATH.

tidbits.title: gh is the API, git is the diary
tidbits.body: gh auth status. gh repo list jesseray718 --limit 10. Push only hangs. Do not push dump/.

tidbits.title: Fork is the phone daemon
tidbits.eta_note: Termux syncthing cli is not truth
tidbits.body: Mesh path /storage/emulated/0/openroot. IDs WD53PPW phone, JW5PQXV box. Recreate .stfolder as a directory if stall at 99 percent.

tidbits.title: 7B lives on the box
tidbits.eta_note: A15 3.5GB cannot host 7B Q4 plus OS
tidbits.body: llama-server on jesse@optiplex3060. Models in /home/jesse/models. Phone is client via http://192.168.1.193:8080/v1

tidbits.title: ledger is local
tidbits.eta_note: WAL file next to db is normal
tidbits.body: A15 db /data/data/com.termux/files/home/code/openroot/kit/openroot_kit.sqlite  SSH db /home/jesse/openroot/kit/openroot_kit.sqlite  Not the same file unless meshed on purpose.

tidbits.title: shrink the PAT
tidbits.body: Replace god token with repo+workflow+read:org. Never paste the token into chat.

tidbits.title: quoted EOF is one paste
tidbits.body: cat > FILE << 'EOF' then every line then EOF then the run line. If prompt shows > you are inside the heredoc. Finish it.
